title: Jaren package site document — frontmatter
description: The frontmatter grammar of a workspace's site.md: the structured metadata the website needs about a package, committed WITH the package. The markdown body below the frontmatter is the package's documentation section and its grammar is markdown itself (jaren-md-ast.schema.json describes what the parser produces). A document whose frontmatter fails this schema is refused by the collector, named by its path — the site never renders a package card the workspace did not describe.

package.description: The published name of the workspace this document sits in. The collector cross-checks it against the package.json beside it, so a document copied between workspaces is refused rather than silently advertising the wrong package.

card.description: The package's card on the site: its own words about what it is.

perf.description: The authored voice of the card's measured line — what the numbers are ABOUT, never a number. Every figure the site publishes is derived from a committed measurement, so a digit here would be a claim nothing can keep true; the pattern refuses one. Where a benchmark headline exists (an engine entry naming a suite), it replaces this line entirely.

engines.description: The engine cards this package contributes to the site's engine grid, in the order the package wants them shown. Most packages carry one; a package that publishes several engines (the addressing engines of @jarenjs/json, the JOSL and CSV readers) carries one entry each, because the grid is a list of ENGINES and a card per package would hide them. A package that is not an engine — a component, a locale pack, a meta-schema bundle — writes no engines member and contributes no card.

key.description: The id the site's engine grid and the playground know this engine by.

suite.description: A published benchmark suite key. The card's measured line is that suite's headline, derived at render time — the card never states the figure itself.

title.description: The engine's own name on the grid. Omitted, the package's card title stands — which is what a single-engine package wants.

blurb.description: The engine's own words. Omitted, the package's card blurb stands.

perf.description: The engine's authored perf voice, under the same no-digit rule as the card's. Omitted, the package's card perf stands.
